editorial:
Imagine starting college and thinking your biggest worry is passing your classes, only to get sucked into a world of magic and monsters. You follow Debbie and Marcie, two freshmen who go to a sorority party and discover the wild world of role playing games. At first, it seems like a fun hobby, but it quickly turns into an obsession. You get to see how these girls stop caring about their real lives and start chasing occult powers. The vibe is a mix of a college drama and a creepy fantasy story that feels like a bad dream you cannot wake up from.

You will probably notice that the acting is a bit raw, but that actually fits the indie feel of the film. The way the story speeds up as they start using real spells and summoning demons is pretty wild. While some parts move a bit slow, the weird twists keep you interested. If you love stories about people losing their grip on reality, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends in total chaos as the game becomes way too real. Debbie tries to control her professor using a mind spell, but things go wrong. Meanwhile, Marcie opens the Necronomicon and actually brings Cthulhu into the world. The line between the game and real life disappears completely. You see that their obsession leads to a scary ending where the monsters they played with finally take over their lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves RPGs and occult horror stories.
